HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Reusable customers and items reduce repeated entry, while calculated totals and clear document actions keep invoicing straightforward.

01

Open a new invoice and select the relevant customer.

04

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about lightning fast invoicing

Does invoice creation always take under 60 seconds?

Speed depends on the invoice and available saved records; the workflow is designed to reduce unnecessary steps.

Can I use saved customers and products?

Yes. Supported customer and item records can be selected while preparing an invoice.

Can I send the invoice electronically?

The application includes supported email and secure public-sharing workflows.

Can invoices be printed or downloaded?

Yes. Supported invoice output includes PDF download and printing.
